entries.reason: Test review found incomplete acceptance-review coverage across artifact writing, blocker classification, decision routing, completion guard, and migration parity tests.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned FAIL with six blocking findings.
entries.resolution: Expanded spec-local tests to use schema-valid artifacts and cover artifact writing, reportRefs, classifier categories, all decision branches, unresolved completion guards, hook promotion, and parity behavior.
entries.guardrailCandidate: When writing spec-local tests for flow behavior, include production boundary tests for artifact creation, routing branches, and completion guards instead of schema-only fixtures.

entries.reason: Second test review still found R14 migration parity coverage incomplete after the initial repair.

entries.guardrailCandidate: Broad migration parity requirements should have a dedicated parity test file with one assertion group per preserved public surface.

entries.reason: Third test review found the R14 final-regression promotion assertion overclaimed by checking only acceptance-review context.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned a blocking finding for the acceptance-review pass path.
entries.resolution: Renamed the context test and added a pass-path test that completes acceptance-review with a pass artifact and asserts next-action promotes final-regression.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Test names for parity requirements must directly match the asserted production behavior, especially promotion paths.

entries.reason: Fourth test review found R2 lacked coverage for normal non-review and non-gate maxAttempts preservation.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test returned a blocking R2 retry-preservation finding.
entries.resolution: Added representative maxAttempts assertions for draft, spec, test, scenario-validity, implement, test-execute, test-result-review, retro, final-regression, and finalize leaves.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Policy-assignment tests must cover explicit changed classes and representative unchanged classes when the requirement includes preservation behavior.

entries.reason: Scenario-validity classified R10 through R12 and R15 as invalid tests after adding static imports for a not-yet-created acceptance-review helper module.
entries.trigger: senti flow run scenario-validity blocked with invalid_test classifications for decision-routing and completion-guard tests.
entries.resolution: Changed the missing helper module references to dynamic per-test loads so pre-implementation failures remain attributable to individual requirement tests.
entries.guardrailCandidate: Spec-local tests for future modules should avoid top-level imports of not-yet-created files so scenario-validity can classify requirement-level expected failures.

entries.reason: Reset test-review rerun found remaining test-design gaps for reset behavior, public acceptance-review command coverage, hardBlocker pass prevention, and caller-supplied reportRefs without report.json.
entries.trigger: senti flow run review --phase test after retry reset returned FAIL with four blocking findings.
entries.resolution: Added done-state reset preconditions, switched R10 to the public flow run acceptance-review path with a controlled artifact seam, added hardBlocker pass prevention, and asserted reportRefs are omitted when report.json is absent even if supplied.
entries.guardrailCandidate: After retry reset, repair tests by exercising public command paths and negative cases for each requirement phrase the review identifies.

entries.reason: Scenario-validity briefly blocked because decision-routing.test.js had an extra closing parenthesis after adding reset preconditions.

entries.resolution: Removed the extra parenthesis and reran scenario-validity successfully.
entries.guardrailCandidate: After manual test edits, run scenario-validity before review so syntax errors are caught as test-design issues before static review.

entries.reason: Test review found R6 and R7 negative coverage only checked a subset of required finding and proposal fields.

entries.resolution: Changed R6 and R7 tests to omit each required field one at a time and assert schema validation rejects every omission.
entries.guardrailCandidate: For schema requirements listing required fields, tests should cover every listed field rather than representative omissions.

entries.reason: Test review found R14 still lacked persisted acceptance-review to final-regression state promotion and finalize leaf approval parity coverage.

entries.guardrailCandidate: Migration parity tests should verify persisted state transitions and approval flags, not only next-action shape.

entries.reason: Test review found R4 acceptance-review next-action coverage checked values but not the full public envelope key set.
